newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias surges on JG Summit buy-in plan.
newsitem.headline: Victorias surges on JG Summit buy-in plan.

text.p: Sugar miller Victorias Milling Co gained 66 centavos, or 46.48 percent, to 2.08 pesos at mid-session on Friday on news JG Summit Holdings Inc was interested in buying into the cash-strapped firm, brokers said.

"The proposed buy-in could be a saviour to Victorias. It's good for them that somebody with a good cash position and a lot of resources is trying to get in," Helen Alvarez, research director at All Asia Securities said.
JG Summit chairman John Gokongwei said on Wednesday that his company wanted to take a majority stake in Victorias but he did not disclose details.
JG Summit operates three sugar mills in the country.
Victorias and its trading arm have sought a moratorium on the payment of debts totalling six billion pesos due to a slump in the local sugar industry.
JG Summit was unchanged in midtrade at 5.20 pesos.
